H_protocol: H1 actual literal scene evidence; H2 amplified disposition with intensity-transfer caution; H3 requires behavior dependent on the local punchline; H4 requires actual nonliteral license. Staging, in-world magic, genre vocabulary and metascene speech do not by themselves warrant H3/H4.
L_protocol: L0 portable content; L1 materially particular wording/rhythm; L2 pragmatic/register effect; L3 central Japanese form needing reconstruction or annotation. No automatic L3 from script, idiom or fantasy nouns.

records.whole_selected_premise: Flight with a loaded bag is stopped by companions who infer new offenses.
records.L_rationale: Bag, attempted departure and mistaken guesses are portable propositions.
records.H_rationale: Taylor physically stops Dust and Keith supplies guesses while Dust withholds the real identity issue.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Offense guesses are not new proven crimes.

records.whole_selected_premise: An intimate old name defeats the appearance disguise, while childish innocence answers a planning accusation.
records.L_rationale: Private full-name address and self-name elongated innocence are recipient-specific performances.
records.H_rationale: Dust recognizes the princess and infers deliberate substitution against her claimed coincidence.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Exact targeting is his inference; Leen and princess remain distinct people.

records.whole_selected_premise: A request for veto receives a cheerful no, and commanded familiarity has to repair habitual courtesy.
records.L_rationale: Polite-to-casual self-repair exposes independent rank and history under a private instruction.
records.H_rationale: Her refusal leaves a difficult personal appeal rather than free refusal of the substitution.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Predicted bodily safety does not remove coercive detention of Leen.

records.whole_selected_premise: Royal food funding changes reluctance into immediate work enthusiasm.
records.L_rationale: Changed incentive and actual departure are portable.
records.H_rationale: Dust amplifies reward-driven eagerness and imagines excess recovery.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Funding is offered, not shown paid; contemplated surplus is not a legitimate completed claim.

records.whole_selected_premise: Mocking people for coercive gullibility ends in a failed grand offer of his own apology.
records.L_rationale: 謝ってやる frames his own prostration as a concession to the surrounding crowd.
records.H_rationale: Provocation and lack of self-blame escalate until he is beaten despite defeating three.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Actual beating remains; his prostration offer is not a demand that the crowd apologize.

records.whole_selected_premise: A competent sales team completes the chore while Dust invents a drinking excuse and fights the employer.
records.L_rationale: The employer begins 納得 then explicitly reverses it when the excuse implies drinking before work.
records.H_rationale: Princess and child actually sell the goods; Dust insults the job and receives the fight.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not credit his fight with sales or treat the cover story as actual drinking.

records.whole_selected_premise: An actual business boundary is obeyed, but food buys a secret the child had just agreed to keep.
records.L_rationale: Owned shop boundary and changed child incentive survive paraphrase.
records.H_rationale: Small threatens complaint and Dust leaves; princess obtains the species/service secret through a meal inducement.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The secrecy favor debt is claimed, not completed service or blanket consent.

records.whole_selected_premise: A food invitation cannot survive the invitee acting too reluctant to accept.
records.L_rationale: Face-saving grand reluctance collapses into explicit pleading when the invitation is withdrawn.
records.H_rationale: Yun asks to join and is welcomed, then overenthusiasm strains the disguised princess.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Yun offers to pay her own share; embarrassment does not prove global social incapacity.

records.whole_selected_premise: An apology to the ideal knight expressly excludes the person who is that knight.
records.L_rationale: The recipient contrast between knight address and Dust is the point of the polite apology.
records.H_rationale: Yun has more real shared history than Dust expected but lacks his concealed identity.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The Iris-mediated legend is mostly, not completely, correct; withheld errors are not invented.

records.whole_selected_premise: A species-based avoidance plan is defeated by the child wanting another profitable visit.
records.L_rationale: Hair-for-snacks history contradicts Dust's assumed hostility.
records.H_rationale: Child reports a personally desired trade and Dust rejects a new hair-profit scheme because of baldness cost.
records.eligibility_and_limits: This separate reported exchange cannot authorize Dust's earlier payment with child materials.

records.whole_selected_premise: Royal privilege is refused because the royal customer is currently pretending to be someone else.
records.L_rationale: 今はリーン applies the disguise's pragmatic obligations against its beneficiary.
records.H_rationale: Yun pays her own share and Dust offers to cover the princess's shortfall at interest.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Offer is not proven settlement; recipient is princess, not genuine Leen.

records.whole_selected_premise: A supposed impossible daily Explosion is immediately heard and treated as normal by the town.
records.L_rationale: Disbelief, actual blast and fast revision are portable evidence.
records.H_rationale: Princess updates after seeing the lack of public alarm.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Commonness is not harmlessness; Wiz's apparent death later yields actual revival.

records.whole_selected_premise: Silence becomes more secure, perhaps, if an unwanted product is purchased.
records.L_rationale: Possibility phrasing softens a concrete purchase inducement over shared secret knowledge.
records.H_rationale: Dust buys while trusting Vanir's promise-keeping rather than learning the object's function.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Purchase is actual; unknown product efficacy is not verified and secrecy is a distinct benefit.

records.whole_selected_premise: A popularity purchase expands to monsters after assent, while a useful check on Leen is deferred for next time.
records.L_rationale: Yun commits before hearing target scope; Dust remembers usable divination only while walking to drinks.
records.H_rationale: Desire and deferred inquiry shape two different actors' choices.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Yun's check failure is not Dust's; Dust knows detention but not the later private choices of Leen.

records.whole_selected_premise: A search expert knows the princess so well that the genuine stranger cannot prove she is a stranger.
records.L_rationale: The declared need to discard common sense and denial of 節穴 are expressly turned against the expert.
records.H_rationale: Butler refuses face/guild verification, binds Leen and transports her against protest.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Expertise is actually fallible here; later role acceptance does not erase initial force.

records.whole_selected_premise: Alcoholic capacity is offered as reassurance to the person who fears it precisely from experience.
records.L_rationale: 知ってるから reverses the claimed reason for reassurance; spoken シクシク exposes performed crying.
records.H_rationale: Dust warns about known disruption and identifies the tearless performance.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not every feeling is therefore false and later drinking is not all proven an act.

records.whole_selected_premise: Private equality stops short of releasing the entertaining caretaker from duty.
records.L_rationale: Segmented refusal and official courtesy collide with requested bare-name intimacy.
records.H_rationale: Princess denies relief and knight refuses unsafe public familiarity despite private permission.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Institutional power and affection coexist; no consent from politeness alone.

records.whole_selected_premise: Menacing approach becomes dirt removal and punishment until tomorrow is evaded by midnight.
records.L_rationale: Today/tomorrow is reindexed after the lecture crosses midnight.
records.H_rationale: The counter-tease backfires and she actually returns under her self-serving reading.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Mere figurative or temporal phrasing does not require L3 or H4.

records.whole_selected_premise: A forbidden ride becomes a bounded one-day choice after a serious request, then prepacked loot appears.
records.L_rationale: Permission rule, visible distress, changed assent and prepared valuables are actual content.
records.H_rationale: Knight knowingly accepts a day despite professional danger; princess is practically prepared.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Real feeling is not disproved by preparation; ride rule is distinct from the later spear vow.

records.whole_selected_premise: A coercion-sounding letter and pledge pressure are followed by a real offer to stop and a renewed yes.
records.L_rationale: Misleading wording and the explicit 本当に嫌なら exit offer change the force of assent.
records.H_rationale: The maid reads the dangerous note aloud; knight then affirmatively chooses departure.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Actual later choice does not erase earlier pressure or prove the note's literal kidnap account.

records.whole_selected_premise: A speed taunt produces maneuvers that continue after the requester asks to stop.
records.L_rationale: Broken ワタシ地面スキ registers the visible aftermath of overwhelming flight.
records.H_rationale: Knight retaliates through excessive performance while denying that motive.
records.eligibility_and_limits: He hears retraction and ignores it; actual distress is not harmless because she initiated the ride.

records.whole_selected_premise: An alias solves the intimacy request, and a jewel's value is checked only after it has been sold.
records.L_rationale: Alias avoids bare-name address, then 聞かなかった事にしよう performs deliberate nonreceipt of inconvenient knowledge.
records.H_rationale: The national-treasure comparison arrives after actual sale, not before commitment.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Near-treasure value is her report; secrecy adequacy is not full accounting adequacy.

records.whole_selected_premise: Unremembered-night implications make the knight ask for facts, then the letter admits drugging and denies the implication.
records.L_rationale: Explicit later denial corrects the early fear without needing a language-specific device.
records.H_rationale: Princess manipulates uncertainty to pass the return deadline and escape.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Non-graphic false claim; no completed sexual encounter or consent inferred.

records.whole_selected_premise: Figurative being pushed around meets threatened literal binding, then apology precedes a pepper escape.
records.L_rationale: The explicit physical/figurative contrast and repeated apology frame the reversal.
records.H_rationale: Princess actually throws pepper after receiving water and delays the return again.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Dragon discomfort is real; future meat payment remains a promise.

records.whole_selected_premise: A bound passenger pays for the dragon's headshake and warns that spear practice may cut her rope.
records.L_rationale: 横揺れ specifies the bodily consequence of what is otherwise an answer to a philosophical question.
records.H_rationale: Knight ignores complaints while actual restraint and exposure continue.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No printed cut or fall; adaptation to the ride cannot retrospectively supply permission.

records.whole_selected_premise: An apology round teaches social ease, while rough speech is appended mechanically to an impeccably polite sentence.
records.L_rationale: はい、分かりました、ぜ mixes the trained rough particle with unaltered polite construction.
records.H_rationale: Knight learns social repair but has not yet learned a natural rough persona.
records.eligibility_and_limits: The round is actually paid; later natural 俺 does not mean this first attempt was already natural.

records.whole_selected_premise: One small gamble becomes forty named losses plus more, while the player insists he dislikes gambling.
records.L_rationale: Loss chasing, continued play and admitted fun contradict the denial.
records.H_rationale: Jealousy of princess's wins amplifies his desire to force one victory.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Dealer's reasoned denial does not independently establish fairness; royal winnings finance continuation.

records.whole_selected_premise: The role of destitute victim is rehearsed again in front of the owner being falsely accused.
records.L_rationale: The demanded theatrical redo and owner's やり直すな expose the deliberate performance.
records.H_rationale: Actual harassment produces a painful escape; knight refuses the proposed attack on civilians.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Invented wife/child/starvation and abuse allegations are false; staging does not erase actual costs.

records.whole_selected_premise: An order to be free is accompanied by physically making the subject smile.
records.L_rationale: A spontaneous prior smile and commanded facial movement are different observations.
records.H_rationale: Princess uses status authority to teach freedom after the knight recognizes real enjoyment.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not infer either total liberation or that all prior delight was coerced.

records.whole_selected_premise: The desired rough alias comes from taking knightly pride as literal dust.
records.L_rationale: ほこり connects 誇り and 埃 to the English-derived ダスト; the Japanese homophony is central and needs reconstruction or annotation.
records.H_rationale: Princess supplies the name and knight notices the wrong sense while accepting it.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Native receptionist line リーン conflicts with the otherwise リール alias; retain the inconsistency.

records.whole_selected_premise: Perfect statistics deter recruitment through boasting, then the allegedly new registrant already has a forbidden revealing class.
records.L_rationale: Bragging, existing card record and exposure are portable causal facts.
records.H_rationale: Forgotten ceremony defeats disguise; covered spear makes an escape gap after couple cover fails.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Hero-blood lore is fictional; pre-vow spear use is not a later-promise breach.

records.whole_selected_premise: A real promise of another adventure does not include the added intimacy clause, and 俺 later comes out naturally.
records.L_rationale: Explicit refusal of an unmade term and narrated unperformed-to-natural pronoun change matter.
records.H_rationale: He checks the attempted promise expansion and recognizes changed ordinary speech.
records.eligibility_and_limits: One real check counters universal underchecking; no acoustic experiment or irreversible personality result.

records.whole_selected_premise: The private willing flight must officially count as kidnapping to preserve royal face.
records.L_rationale: そうなっている marks an imposed institutional account despite known initiative.
records.H_rationale: Retinue retrieval leads to actual exile, house abolition and prohibition of the old name.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Do not adopt the official label as the exact voluntary-choice history or erase actual coercion elsewhere.

records.whole_selected_premise: Half-bravado freedom gives way to a declined escape hand, an actual sword gift and a precise conditional spear vow.
records.L_rationale: 半分本音で半分強がり explicitly limits the farewell claim; the exception wording matters.
records.H_rationale: Princess chooses duty, gives the sword and accepts the new restraint for herself or another truly protected person.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not an absolute no-spear rule; the full origin context is new here, the exact rule was already read in Dust03.

records.whole_selected_premise: Sleeping adventure talk receives the old courteous reply after the other men have been cleared away with drink.
records.L_rationale: Private old courtesy returns beneath current rough public identity.
records.H_rationale: Dust replies warmly but actual forced extra alcohol remains the means of privacy.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Princess's additional drugging is disclosed next chapter; not backfilled into his present knowledge.

records.whole_selected_premise: Absent teammates are explained by actual drugging, while a five-second invitation rejects the invitee's request for manners.
records.L_rationale: The invitation's countdown overrides a pragmatic request for a proper solicitation.
records.H_rationale: Dust pressures Yun and princess criticizes him after admitting her own coercive removal of the men.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Later joining does not make the initial objection insincere or teammates' absence freely chosen.

records.whole_selected_premise: The shop worker is grabbed before terms, then chooses after an admired object is named and only later hears about the worm.
records.L_rationale: それを早く言って asks for reward information that should precede uptake.
records.H_rationale: Cup inducement recruits Small after an objection; the task's second monster is initially withheld.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Manager wave is not her assent; cup authenticity/delivery remain unshown.

records.whole_selected_premise: Sympathy does not include carrying, and a drinking cover is contradicted by missing smell and work observation.

records.H_rationale: Princess refuses the burden and Small questions the cover Yun accepted.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Child now voluntarily accepts the carrier; this does not amend Dust05 resistance.

records.whole_selected_premise: A spectacular spell misses the target and a boastful caster is swallowed while Dust asks how warm it is.

records.H_rationale: Dust substitutes mockery for protective action; Yun explicitly stops the teasing and frees her.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Credible coercive danger needs no completed injury. No rescue credit to Dust, later-success exemption or H3 excuse.

records.whole_selected_premise: Both people intend to dodge the offered hug in the same direction and collide.
records.L_rationale: Symmetric avoidance produces an unintended actual impact.
records.H_rationale: Head pain follows, child pursues food and Yun supplies cleanup.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not a mutually accepted hug; cleanup does not erase force or pain.

records.whole_selected_premise: The worm allegedly absent is under Dust, and a first-rescuer prize mobilizes three helpers before the fake reward can be checked.
records.L_rationale: 先着一名様 uses competitive promotional exclusivity to recruit simultaneous effort.
records.H_rationale: Unavailable waist sword and increasing capture make the actual rescue costly; child approaches for food rather than the assumed concern.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Dust knows the bun is counterfeit; recipients' checking is distinct. Delivery is deferred/unshown.

records.whole_selected_premise: Both sexual and romantic explanations for clothing miss the wearer simply liking it.
records.L_rationale: A direct first-person preference defeats two other people's motive guesses.
records.H_rationale: Small then rejects irrational-anger framing after Dust answers a frankness request with insult.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Non-graphic; clothing preference or requesting frankness does not authorize harassment or restraint.

records.whole_selected_premise: Defense of a not-quite-friend is followed by paralysis, while a win-win claim is corrected by naming the victim's loss.
records.L_rationale: Friend-status hedging and the explicit excluded loser repair Dust's framing.
records.H_rationale: Princess and Small immobilize the visitor; princess stops Dust's unwanted exposure attempt.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Unable to resist is not consent; no automatic harmless roleplay or complete enemy identity knowledge.

records.whole_selected_premise: Dust assumes a comfortable guest, while the confined guest learns the maid knew all along she was a substitute.
records.L_rationale: Divergent access and planned collusion explain the contrast.
records.H_rationale: Leen's protests and avoided property damage precede the explicit identity admission.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Maid's pay is reported; earlier butler error remains real and later choice is not yet available to Dust.

records.whole_selected_premise: Two troublesome traits are multiplied rather than averaged, and repeated indifference accompanies reading every word of old history.
records.L_rationale: 割らないで掛ける explicitly replaces the expected averaging formula; repeated 本当に strains the denial.
records.H_rationale: Leen's jealous curiosity and maid's amplified appraisal overcome the indifference claim.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Trait multiplication is figurative, not a numerical score; the photo corroborates depicted figures, not every story detail.

records.whole_selected_premise: Role acceptance first eliminates the right to quit, then that right is explicitly reoffered and continuation chosen.
records.L_rationale: 拒否権はございません is a real blocked exit, distinct from the later compensation/escort offer.
records.H_rationale: Leen first asks withdrawal, then later chooses another day for her own retaliatory aim.
records.eligibility_and_limits: A whip is a visible threat, not a printed strike; later assent cannot rewrite the earlier captivity.

records.whole_selected_premise: The drugger offers a moderation proverb to the victims blaming their own drinking.
records.L_rationale: 酒は飲んでも飲まれるな conceals her known alternative cause under a familiar maxim.
records.H_rationale: Dust knows the drugging yet changes sympathy into a meal charge after ordinary criticism.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Actual funding burden remains; no freely chosen penalty terms or natural alcohol-only absence.

records.whole_selected_premise: A threat to involve bystanders meets indifference, then a lecture against drinking is delivered to a guild full of drinkers.
records.L_rationale: The audience-sensitive venue question exposes the bad persuasion choice.
records.H_rationale: Crowd forces alcohol on Perie and prevents her mission for a time.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Forced hospitality remains compulsion; no actual bystander killing or solitary Dust trap credited.

records.whole_selected_premise: Dust notices an uncharacteristic warning but both sides have completely missed the other's identity plan.
records.L_rationale: A sound specific question coexists with later admitted wrong assumptions.
records.H_rationale: Perie reveals demon-army employment and misreads the substitution as strategic foresight.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No omniscient mastermind inferred; clear speech outside does not prove all earlier intoxication fake.

records.whole_selected_premise: An explicitly false claim of low hostage value succeeds only by turning capture into a killing plan.
records.L_rationale: Known lie, changed enemy aim and shield action are portable.
records.H_rationale: Dust recognizes his tactic has worsened danger and steps in front.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Popular princess is not actually hated; no pure-motive or total-success requirement added to rearrangement.

records.whole_selected_premise: An apparent abandonment brings the spear, and the easy solo escape is refused because she would be pursued.
records.L_rationale: Actual return, available weapon and particular-protection appraisal are explicit.
records.H_rationale: Dust changes reach/angle with a planted spear and exploits the rush, after choosing to stay.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Graphic aftermath is not reproduced; no independent final death check. No competing leisure in this positive protection scene.

records.whole_selected_premise: A direct assent question receives a refusal to leave until the would-be rescuer comes apologizing.
records.L_rationale: The maid's embellished message and requested bowed apology replace Dust's assumed helpless-hostage script.
records.H_rationale: Dust checks Leen's agreement, but staff really block retrieval and the later window confirms anger.
records.eligibility_and_limits: His reflection-game inference does not prove all confinement harmless; private release offers were unknown to him.

records.whole_selected_premise: Rescue volunteers receive an invented heiress drama, then the chosen distraction is rejected as unnecessarily criminal.
records.L_rationale: という設定 explicitly marks the recruitment story as a fabrication; Yun challenges its needless ingredient.
records.H_rationale: The first proposal is withdrawn after real objections; recruitment still rests on false facts.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Non-graphic; no orphan status, real forced wedding, or performed rejected act inferred.

records.whole_selected_premise: A critic is made to perform her own idea, and the result discourages everyone from suggesting ideas.
records.L_rationale: 批判だけなら is used as a responsibility challenge with an observable chilling effect.
records.H_rationale: Yun actually attempts the inaudible gate appeal and princess supplies the useful split plan.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Rebuke is reported after her return; Dust does not author every part of the plan.

records.whole_selected_premise: Bad acting still draws guards, but fire is rejected specifically because Leen is inside.
records.L_rationale: Successful diversion and the named collateral concern are portable facts.
records.H_rationale: Yun enjoys being sought, men sustain roles, and Dust stops the proposed ignition.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Staff harm is expressly discounted; helper participation under false facts is not fully informed assent.

records.whole_selected_premise: A possible jealous admission is clarified as calling his statement bad, while old love receives a sincere wedding congratulations.
records.L_rationale: 悪い？/悪い、って言った resolves uptake; official congratulations now lack the old agitation.
records.H_rationale: Dust denies likeness explains all later relations and accepts the princess's future wedding.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Leen's unfinished quiet words are not a completed heard confession; wedding remains future.

records.whole_selected_premise: Food bargaining becomes an explicit partner request and the child willingly reveals the dragon form.
records.L_rationale: 相棒 addresses a reciprocal partner instead of treating capacity as automatic property.
records.H_rationale: Child positively agrees and staff finally see how the dragon escaped as a human.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Specific assent does not retroactively authorize earlier material payments or carrier force.

records.whole_selected_premise: The apparent two-knight aerial duel is actually arranged for a concealed provider's mental spell.
records.L_rationale: Position, supplied spear, finger signal and actual intervention explain the result.
records.H_rationale: Small completes the prearranged action and dragons land the unconscious riders safely.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Her battle-scene commentary is not by itself H3. Capacity/provider recruitment precede reveal to reader; no solo rank result.

records.whole_selected_premise: An embarrassing princess address is specific to Leen, but the hand is untaken and the initial lift resisted.
records.L_rationale: Repeated my-princess address names the present protected person after the past relationship is explained.
records.H_rationale: Dust retrieves her through flight; later shoulder contact and teasing are actual separate choices.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Warm later flight is not permission for the initial lift, nor a mutual dating contract; IMG018 depicts only the earlier open hand.

records.whole_selected_premise: A claim that nothing progressed meets companions' long-awaited recognition, then everyone backs the other side of the fight.
records.L_rationale: ようやく and the unison 日頃の行い undercut Dust's private framing.
records.H_rationale: Leen actually punches and Dust appraises the noisy guild as home while under attack.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No blanket moral justification of violence from reputation or proof every guild member agrees to every cost.

records.whole_selected_premise: A public love declaration used to embarrass is answered by a headbutt and a quiet setting-specific qualification he misses.
records.L_rationale: こんな場所じゃ limits the private embarrassment statement, while the declaration has a local teasing function.
records.H_rationale: Actual physical rejection and unheard reader-access line coexist before the emergency summons.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No automatic harmless affection or formal relationship settlement; raid is rumored/summoned, not performed.

records.whole_selected_premise: The author reacts to supplied past Dust with who is this?
records.L_rationale: 誰だこれ is the author's quoted recognition reaction.
records.H_rationale: Attributed surprise frames the contrast between past court behavior and current manner.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Paratext report, not an independent reader or proof the character is incoherent.

records.whole_selected_premise: A request that an editor secretly provide the missed bonus novel closes on an explicit film-title echo.
records.L_rationale: くれない in the request echoes 紅 in 紅伝説, then だけに explicitly flags the pun; the form requires reconstruction or annotation.
records.H_rationale: Author reports missing the initial bonus and addresses a wish rather than obtaining it.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Authorial language effect, not narrative prediction evidence; no root movie viewing or absent bonus-story reading.
